Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Graystone is excited about shipping a small pilot that pairs our consultancy services with your Integrate+Train enablement package. Attached is a first draft of the playbook we discussed (IntegrateTrain_Playbook_v0.4.pdf).

High level ask: can you (or someone from Redwood) review the draft and confirm a two-hour hands-on training window for our joint delivery team in the week of Dec 8? We want a mix of architecture review (30m), sandbox walkthrough (45m), and role-based labs (45m).

Questions from our side:
- Do you provide a temporary sandbox with example prompts and rate-limit-friendly traffic shaping?
- Any security paperwork (SOC2 artifacts, IP terms) we should prep before the training?

I've looped in Priya from ClientCo since they're the pilot customer and will want to attend the session.

Attachments: IntegrateTrain_Playbook_v0.4.pdf (35 pages)

Best,

Tom — great to hear, and thanks for the draft. I skimmed the playbook and left a couple of inline comments in Drive (link below). High-level: this looks like a good structure and aligns with our typical partner enablement flows.

Short answers up front:
- Sandbox: yes, we can provision an ephemeral sandbox (48hr token/limited capacity) with example prompt sets and guidance. Jordan will own provisioning and the lab exercises.
- Security paperwork: we can share a high-level SOC2 evidence outline ahead of the session; for anything beyond that we usually route to our compliance intake (we can fast-track initial items for the pilot).

Proposed training agenda (90-120m):
1) 10m — Introductions & pilot goals (Evelyn/Tom/Priya)
2) 30m — Architecture & integration patterns (Rishi + partner engineering)
3) 40m — Sandbox walkthrough & guided lab (Jordan)
4) 30m — Q&A, support model, next steps (all)

Suggested slots (Pacific):
- Tue Dec 9, 09:00–11:00 PST
- Wed Dec 10, 13:00–15:00 PST
- Thu Dec 11, 08:30–10:30 PST

Jordan — can you confirm sandbox capacity (token limits) and whether we want to pre-seed example KV caches for the lab?

Tom/Priya — if any of the above conflicts with your calendar, flag preferred slots and we’ll lock one.

Drive playbook link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bIntegrateTrainPlaybook

Thanks,

Eve — quick update on sandbox and lab prep.

- Sandbox capacity: we can spin a partner sandbox with a 10k token/day soft limit; we’ll throttle above that and surface errors in the dashboard. For the lab, we will pre-seed two common KV cache samples (customer-profile, conversation-history) and a small dataset (1k rows) so participants can exercise retrieval/augment flows.
- Access: will provision temporary API keys tied to the Graystone org; keys expire after 7 days unless extended.
- Environment: advice — run labs on the smaller model variant (gpt-medium-quant) to keep latency/payloads predictable.

Operational ask: can Product/Sales sign off on the training slide deck and confirm who will present the architecture section? Rishi, want to take point there?

Also — Tom asked about SOC2 artifacts. I can attach the outline we usually send as a pre-read; Evelyn, want me to send that to the external list or wait until you sign off?

Thanks,
Jordan
Partner Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
